nodes.title: Implement to_superpauli conversion function
nodes.description: Implement the public to_superpauli function that converts a superoperator to the Pauli basis representation. The function should: (1) Accept Qobj inputs of type 'super' (with superrep 'super', 'choi', or 'chi') or type 'oper', (2) For 'super' superrep, directly apply the basis transformation using the existing _superpauli_basis helper and the pattern from _to_superpauli, (3) For other representations, convert to super first then apply transformation, (4) Validate that dimensions are qubit dimensions using isqubitdims, (5) Follow the pattern of existing to_* functions (to_super, to_choi, to_chi) with proper docstring and error handling.
nodes.expected_output: A complete to_superpauli function implementation with signature to_superpauli(q_oper: Qobj) -> Qobj, including comprehensive docstring documenting parameters, return value, raises section, and notes about Pauli basis representation.

nodes.title: Implement superpauli_to_super conversion function
nodes.description: Implement the superpauli_to_super function that converts a superoperator from the Pauli basis back to the column-stacking superoperator representation. This is the inverse transformation of to_superpauli. The function should: (1) Accept a Qobj representing a superoperator in Pauli basis, (2) Apply the inverse basis transformation B @ q_oper @ B.dag() where B is the appropriately scaled Pauli basis from _superpauli_basis, (3) Validate qubit dimensions using isqubitdims, (4) Return a superoperator with superrep='super', (5) Include proper docstring following QuTiP conventions.
nodes.expected_output: A complete superpauli_to_super function implementation with signature superpauli_to_super(q_oper: Qobj) -> Qobj, including comprehensive docstring documenting parameters, return value, raises section, and notes about the inverse transformation.

nodes.title: Integrate new functions into module exports
nodes.description: Add both to_superpauli and superpauli_to_super to the __all__ export list. Place the new function implementations in the module at an appropriate location (near other to_* functions like to_super, to_choi, to_chi). Return the complete modified Python file with: (1) Updated __all__ list containing 'to_superpauli' and 'superpauli_to_super', (2) Both new function implementations integrated into the module, (3) All existing functionality and imports preserved.
nodes.expected_output: The COMPLETE modified Python file with both new functions added and __all__ updated to include 'to_superpauli' and 'superpauli_to_super'. Not a fragment. Not just the new functions. The entire file from the first import to the last line.
